mechanism_correction: Previous relative readout still required a unique global target. Ranking supervision only needs a local pair. Unknown candidates are not negatives. All previous failure artifacts preserved.
pair_rule: Both independent same-class depth-separated mask components map to source query sets. Full-caption YES/NO logodds favor m over n by >=ln2; wrong same-scene caption favors n over m by >=ln2. Strongest minimum-gap pair per observation, not a global target claim.
direct_use: Only replace original q0 when q0 lies in the pair negative set; otherwise leave unknown/source candidates alone.
why_direct_gain_need_not_be_positive: A useful local preference may not involve current source Top1; it can still supervise shared matching and must be evaluated on new B.
